title: UAAP: Napa irate, Chambers apologetic over FEU’s late timeout vs. NU
summary: Tensions flared in what was already a decided contest as Far Eastern University head coach Sean Chambers drew the ire of National University mentor Jeff Napa over a late-game timeout.
